corrections.reason: The initial character is 1st-order አ (አሠረ, 'he tied'), not 6th-order እ.
The middle character is clearly 6th-order ስ (ነስሕ, Ge'ez imperative 'repent', matching line 6), not ሥ.
Visually the word has only three glyphs: አድጎ (part of the compound expression አድጎ አድርገዋል, 'bowed down at midday'), not አድንኖ.
The line ends with 6th-order ብ (forming the Ge'ez verb ቀብወ across the line wrap, 'he swelled up'), clearly showing the left-side notch of ብ.
The first glyph is 1st-order ነ (ነፀ እሳት, Ge'ez construct 'arrows/darts of fire' paired with ኵናተ እሳት 'spears of fire'), misread as ጎ.
In the canonical Ge'ez text of Acts 1:22, the gerundive is አኀዞ ('beginning from the baptism of John'), and the middle glyph in the image is ኀ, not ኒ.
The printed glyph is ኒ (archaic Amharic demonstrative ከኒህ ከሁለቱ, 'from these two'), with the top horizontal bar of ነ/ኒ misread as ሊ.
